AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.tautology.short: Proves an affine tautology by the decision procedure for the connectives

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.demorgan_.short: Every affine proposition P has the negation Pᗮ as a De Morgan dual

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.atrue_dua.short: The De Morgan dual of truth 𝐓 is falsity 𝐅

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.afalse_du.short: The De Morgan dual of falsity 𝐅 is truth 𝐓

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.anot_dual.short: The De Morgan dual of a negation Pᗮ is P itself

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_dual.short: If P, Q have duals Pd, Qd, then the dual of P ∧ Q is Pd ∨ Qd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_dual.short: If P, Q have duals Pd, Qd, then the dual of P ∨ Q is Pd ∧ Qd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_dua.short: If P, Q have duals Pd, Qd, then the dual of P ⊠ Q is Pd ⊞ Qd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_dual.short: If P, Q have duals Pd, Qd, then the dual of P ⊞ Q is Pd ⊠ Qd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_dua.short: If Q has dual Qd, then the dual of P ⊸ Q is P ⊠ Qd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_dual.short: The dual of P ⧟ Q is (P ⊠ Qd) ∨ (Pd ⊠ Q)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_dua.short: The dual of Pᗮ ⊠ Q is the implication Q ⊸ P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.of_course.short: If P has dual Pd, then the dual of !P is ?Pd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.why_not_d.short: If P has dual Pd, then the dual of ?P is !Pd

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.contradic.short: A proof of P and a proof of Pᗮ together give falsity

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_by_.short: A proof of the dual of P proves that P implies anything

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.by_contra.short: From proofs of P and of its dual, any affine proposition follows

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.acontra_e.short: P implies Q if and only if Qᗮ implies Pᗮ, affinely

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.acontra_i.short: P ⧟ Q is equivalent, affinely, to Pᗮ ⧟ Qᗮ

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.acontra.short: If P implies Q, then Qᗮ implies Pᗮ

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.acontra_i.short: If P ⧟ Q, then Pᗮ ⧟ Qᗮ

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.contrapos.short: P implies Q if and only if the dual of Q implies the dual of P
P ⧟ Q is equivalent to Pd ⧟ Qd, with Pd, Qd the duals
If Q implies P, then the dual of P implies the dual of Q
If P ⧟ Q, then their duals are equivalent

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.by_contra.short: Proof by contraposition: Qd ⊸ Pd, with the duals in normal form, proves P ⊸ Q
To prove P ⧟ Q it suffices to prove the equivalence of their duals

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_spl.short: Builds P ⊸ Q from P → Q and Qd → Pd in the base logic

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_spli.short: Builds P ⊞ Q from Pd → Q and Qd → P in the base logic

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.why_not_b.short: If the dual of P cannot be proved, then why not P holds

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.decidable.short: A decidable P gives the additive disjunction of P and its dual
P ∨ Pd, with Pd the dual of P, makes P decidable

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.true_aimp.short: 𝐓 implies P if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_fal.short: P implies 𝐅 if and only if Pᗮ

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_true.short: P ⧟ 𝐓 is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_fals.short: P ⧟ 𝐅 is equivalent to Pᗮ

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aandr.short: P ∧ Q implies Q: the right projection of the additive conjunction

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_lub.short: (R ⊸ P) ∧ (R ⊸ Q) implies R ⊸ P ∧ Q: the additive conjunction is a meet

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_intr.short: From R ⊸ P and R ⊸ Q, builds R ⊸ P ∧ Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_asso.short: The additive conjunction is associative: (P ∧ Q) ∧ R if and only if P ∧ (Q ∧ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_com.short: The additive conjunction is commutative: P ∧ Q if and only if Q ∧ P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_unit.short: Truth is a left unit for the additive conjunction: 𝐓 ∧ P if and only if P
Truth is a right unit for the additive conjunction: P ∧ 𝐓 if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_fals.short: Falsity absorbs the additive conjunction: 𝐅 ∧ P if and only if 𝐅
Falsity absorbs the additive conjunction on the right: P ∧ 𝐅 if and only if 𝐅

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_idem.short: The additive conjunction is idempotent: P ∧ P if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aorl.short: P implies P ∨ Q: the left injection into the additive disjunction

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aorr.short: Q implies P ∨ Q: the right injection into the additive disjunction

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_glb.short: (P ⊸ R) ∧ (Q ⊸ R) implies P ∨ Q ⊸ R: the additive disjunction is a join

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_elim.short: From P ⊸ R and Q ⊸ R, builds P ∨ Q ⊸ R: proof by cases

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_assoc.short: The additive disjunction is associative: (P ∨ Q) ∨ R if and only if P ∨ (Q ∨ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_com.short: The additive disjunction is commutative: P ∨ Q if and only if Q ∨ P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_unit_.short: Falsity is a left unit for the additive disjunction: 𝐅 ∨ P if and only if P
Falsity is a right unit for the additive disjunction: P ∨ 𝐅 if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_true_.short: Truth absorbs the additive disjunction: 𝐓 ∨ P if and only if 𝐓
Truth absorbs the additive disjunction on the right: P ∨ 𝐓 if and only if 𝐓

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_idem.short: The additive disjunction is idempotent: P ∨ P if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_aor_.short: The additive disjunction distributes over the additive conjunction: P ∨ (Q ∧ R) if and only if (P ∨ Q) ∧ (P ∨ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_aand_.short: The additive and distributes over the additive or

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_adj.short: Currying: P ⊠ Q ⊸ R if and only if P ⊸ Q ⊸ R

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_adj.short: R ⊸ P ⊞ Q if and only if R ⊠ Pᗮ ⊸ Q: a par disjunct moves across as its negation

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_adj_.short: R ⊸ P ⊞ Q if and only if R ⊠ Pd ⊸ Q, for Pd a normal form of the negation of P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_ass.short: The tensor is associative: (P ⊠ Q) ⊠ R if and only if P ⊠ (Q ⊠ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_com.short: The tensor is commutative: P ⊠ Q if and only if Q ⊠ P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_med.short: The medial law: (P ⊠ Q) ⊠ (R ⊠ S) is equivalent to (P ⊠ R) ⊠ (Q ⊠ S)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_uni.short: Truth is a left unit for the tensor: 𝐓 ⊠ P if and only if P
Truth is a right unit for the tensor: P ⊠ 𝐓 if and only if P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_fal.short: Falsity absorbs the tensor: 𝐅 ⊠ P if and only if 𝐅
Falsity absorbs the tensor on the right: P ⊠ 𝐅 if and only if 𝐅

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_mp_.short: Modus ponens: (P ⊸ Q) ⊠ P implies Q
Modus ponens with the argument first: P ⊠ (P ⊸ Q) implies Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.of_course.short: Of course distributes over the tensor: !(P ⊠ Q) if and only if !P ⊠ !Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_asso.short: The par is associative: (P ⊞ Q) ⊞ R if and only if P ⊞ (Q ⊞ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_com.short: The par is commutative: P ⊞ Q if and only if Q ⊞ P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_unit.short: Falsity is a left unit for par: 𝐅 ⊞ P is equivalent to P
Falsity is a right unit for par: P ⊞ 𝐅 is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_true.short: Truth absorbs par on the left: 𝐓 ⊞ P is equivalent to 𝐓
Truth absorbs par on the right: P ⊞ 𝐓 is equivalent to 𝐓

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.why_not_a.short: Why not distributes over par: ?(P ⊞ Q) is equivalent to ?P ⊞ ?Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_aor.short: P ⊞ Q implies why not (P ∨ Q)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_aor.short: P ⊸ Q ⊞ R is equivalent to (P ⊸ Q) ⊞ R
P ⊸ Q ⊞ R is equivalent to Q ⊞ (P ⊸ R)

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_aim.short: (P ⊸ R) ⊠ (Q ⊸ S) implies that P ⊞ Q implies R ⊞ S

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.of_course.short: Of course is idempotent: !!P is equivalent to !P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.why_not_i.short: Why not is idempotent: ??P is equivalent to ?P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_is_t.short: A proved P is equivalent to truth

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_is_f.short: A refuted P is equivalent to falsity

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aand_true.short: If P holds, P ∧ Q is equivalent to Q
If Q holds, P ∧ Q is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aprod_tru.short: If P holds, P ⊠ Q is equivalent to Q
If Q holds, P ⊠ Q is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aor_is_tr.short: If P holds, P ∨ Q is equivalent to truth
If Q holds, P ∨ Q is equivalent to truth

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_is_t.short: If P holds, P ⊞ Q is equivalent to truth
If Q holds, P ⊞ Q is equivalent to truth

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_is_f.short: If P holds, Pᗮ ⊞ Q is equivalent to Q
If Q holds, P ⊞ Qᗮ is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_tru.short: Given P, the implication P ⊸ Q is equivalent to Q
A proved proposition is implied by every proposition: Q gives P ⊸ Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_is_.short: Given Q, the implication P ⊸ Q is equivalent to truth

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_true.short: Given P, the equivalence P ⧟ Q is equivalent to Q
Given Q, the equivalence P ⧟ Q is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.apar_is_f.short: Given P and a dual Pd of P, the par Pd ⊞ Q is equivalent to Q
Given Q and a dual Qd of Q, the par P ⊞ Qd is equivalent to P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_ref.short: Affine implication is reflexive: P implies P

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_tra.short: Affine implication is transitive: (P ⊸ Q) ⊠ (Q ⊸ R) implies P ⊸ R

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aiff_equi.short: The affine biconditional ⧟ is an equivalence relation on affine propositions

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.aimpl_sub.short: An affine equivalence P ⧟ Q gives the affine implication P ⊸ Q

AffineConstructive.logic.aprop.antisym_a.short: Implications P ⊸ Q and Q ⊸ P together give P ⧟ Q
